selection_basis: Facility signage and notice-board requirements are absent from the canonical bank except for vehicle markings. The batch adds only distinct facility-facing decisions: standard sign specification, required operational information, Class-4 warning wording, warning-board color, and self-service fueling notice.

source_contract.pinpoint_scope: 危険物の規制に関する規則 第17条及び第18条

anti_duplication_rule: Do not restate the vehicle "危" marking, vehicle placement, or general fire-use prohibition. Do not split the same notice-board fact into wording-only variants.
